messages.subject: Corporate & Public Affairs Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Stakeholder Leadership
messages.body:
Dear GKPRCC Team,

Your focus on corporate affairs, public affairs and sustainability leadership is strongly aligned with my executive background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where policy, reputation, sustainability and institutional engagement are strategic priorities. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
